correctness.rationale: The graph and all 93,350 faces are deterministically enumerated. Two distinct vertex-order Morse matchings each pass a whole-Hasse-DAG acyclicity check on 583,750 incidences. The primary signed 246 by 45 boundary has Smith factors 1 repeated 40 and 5 once; the alternate 237 by 36 boundary has factors 1 repeated 31 and 5 once. Exact integer Smith computations and independent modular ranks yield H3=Z^205+Z/5 and H4=Z^4. No critical cells in dimensions 1,2,5 or higher remain. The 3/4-cell CW attachment maps lie in pi3 of a wedge of 3-spheres, so Smith basis changes realize the Moore-space and sphere-wedge homotopy classification. Certificate, checker and limitations are embedded.

value.rationale: The open-neighborhood topology of the canonical 25-vertex Paley graph is mathematically natural and motivated by the 2022 structural work on this exact graph. The explicit five-primary Moore summand in dimension three, four independent fourth-dimensional classes, and non-shellability of a pure 11-complex give complete integral structure not determined by clique counts or ordinary field homology. This is a genuine finite homotopy classification and a reproducible, motivated test case; no unsupported all-Paley theorem is claimed.
